A2 knows gate 5: RIGHT and gate 6: RIGHT. Whoever knows gate 1, broadcast it along with your other known doors. Use only approved gates.
A3 knows gate 4: LEFT and gate 8: LEFT. Known so far: 2 LEFT, 3 RIGHT, 4 LEFT, 5 RIGHT, 6 RIGHT, 8 LEFT. A4, please broadcast gates 1 and 7. Use only approved gates.
A4 knows gate 1: LEFT and gate 7: LEFT. Complete safe route: 1 LEFT, 2 LEFT, 3 RIGHT, 4 LEFT, 5 RIGHT, 6 RIGHT, 7 LEFT, 8 LEFT. Take two approved gates each round to finish within four rounds.
